test_title: SSC CGL 2023 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 20 Jul 2023 Shift 4)
subject: general
question: Which of the following state governments has launched the Paray Shikshalaya scheme in February 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**West Bengal**__.

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The correct answer is option 3, i.e., West Bengal.**
 
• **The Paray Shikshalaya scheme is a new initiative **launched by the **West Bengal government in February 2022.**
 
• The scheme aims to **provide free and quality education** to children living in remote and backward areas of the state.
 
• The scheme will establish 10,000 schools in the state to provide education to around 5 lakh students.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• The West Bengal government on Monday (February 7) launched ‘Paray Shikshalaya’ – an open-air classroom in the neighbourhood program – for students from classes 1 to 7.
 
• The aim of this initiative is to encourage students who dropped out of school during the Covid-19 pandemic to continue their education.
 
• On January 31, schools across the state opened for classes 8 to 12. However, students studying in lower classes continued to take online classes.
 
• Initially, the initiative was meant for primary school students (1 to 5). However, students in classes 6 and 7 were also included as physical classes in schools did not reopen for them.
